title: BobPack manifest
description: pack.json manifest for a BobPack — a versioned bundle of IBM Bob customizations.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference — ignored at validation time.

name.description: Unique pack identifier. Lowercase, digits and single hyphens only. Must match the pack folder name.

description.description: One-sentence description shown on the site and in CLI output.

license.description: SPDX license identifier. Must be an open license.

level.description: Skill level required to use this pack.

integrityStance.description: Required for student and educator packs. Describes whether Bob teaches with hints, gives full solutions, or defers to a course policy file.

ibmProducts.description: IBM products this pack is designed for. Use empty array if none.

bobVersion.description: Compatible Bob version range in semver range syntax (e.g. '>=2.0.0').

tags.description: Free-form tags for search and filtering.

components.description: Declares which component types this pack includes and their configuration.

name.description: Skill directory name. Must match the folder under skills/ in the pack.

path.description: Relative path from pack root to the skill directory (e.g. 'skills/code-tutor').

autoInvoke.description: Whether Bob should auto-invoke this skill based on its description. Defaults to true. Set false to make the skill slash-command only.

modes.description: Custom modes included in this pack.

slug.description: Mode slug — must match the slug: field inside the YAML file. Used for collision detection.

path.description: Relative path from pack root to the mode YAML file (e.g. 'modes/code-tutor.yaml').

rules.description: Rule files included in this pack.

path.description: Relative path from pack root to the rule file.

installTo.description: Target directory relative to .bob/. Use 'rules' for global rules or 'rules-<mode-slug>' for mode-specific rules.

mcp.description: MCP server fragment to merge into .bob/mcp.json.

path.description: Relative path from pack root to the MCP fragment file (e.g. 'mcp/mcp.fragment.json').

agents.description: AGENTS.md snippet to append to the project AGENTS.md.

path.description: Relative path from pack root to the AGENTS.md snippet file (e.g. 'agents/AGENTS.snippet.md').

requires.description: Environment requirements the user must satisfy before installing. No secret values.

name.description: Name of the required CLI, env var name, MCP server slug, or package name.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what this requirement is for.

optional.description: If true, the pack functions without this requirement but with reduced capability.
